name: det
title: Deterministic model: 8 Bloomberg surprise z-scores
description: Stage 2's macro panel: standardised surprises (actual minus consensus) for NFP, retail sales, industrial production, ISM manufacturing, CPI, core CPI, PPI and average hourly earnings, known at the month-end decision. States no direction of its own; the shared learner (purged expanding Ridge) turns the features into a view.
author: Grace, Qianyi
